subject: Hosted API pricing: baseline per-1M token rates & model roster
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmeai.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: baseline per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Dylan,

We're running a quick vendor evaluation and would like Redwood's standard hosted API rate sheet for per-1M token pricing (separate input/output rates if you publish them) and a current list of supported models with their recommended use cases (chat vs. completion vs. embeddings) and any notable performance tiers (e.g., low-latency vs. high-throughput).

A couple of context points to help:
- Expected monthly volume: ~15M tokens in Q1, ramping toward 100M over 12 months (attached a short forecast).
- Primary use: product search and assistant UI (mixture of chat and embedding workloads).
- Compliance: we'll likely require SOC2 evidence during procurement.

If you can send a baseline public rate card and any notes about committed discounts / typical thresholds you offer, that would be very helpful. Also include whether input/output tokens are priced separately and if streaming is billed differently.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of AI Integrations, Acme AI
Procurement: procurement@acmeai.com

Attachments: Acme_Traffic_Forecast.xlsx (xlsx)
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmeai.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: baseline per-1M token rates and model list

Jordan —

Thanks for the context and the forecast. Quick answers up front, and I attached our baseline hosted ratecard PDF for convenience.

Baseline (public) hosted rates — standardized per 1M tokens:
- Input tokens: $0.50 per 1M
- Output tokens: $1.00 per 1M

Notes:
- Rates above are our hosted public list for our common + high-capacity models (non-quantized).
- Streaming responses are billed on output tokens only (same output rate).
- Embeddings are priced separately; see the attached sheet for the small-batch and bulk tiers.

Model roster (short):
- rwd-llama-3-13b: low-latency chat/completion (good for UI assistants)
- rwd-llama-3-70b: higher quality completions, higher cost per token
- rwd-embed-2: embeddings optimized for semantic search (per-embedding pricing on sheet)
- rwd-compact-quant: cost-optimized quantized variants (available for hosted and dedicated)

If you expect predictable committed volume, we can offer stepped discounts at commit bands (e.g., 5–15%, depending on term and volume) and preferred ratecards for annual committed contracts. To scope that properly, can you confirm the % of tokens you expect to be chat vs embeddings vs bulk completions? Marissa (copied) is our lead SE and can run a quick cost projection for the forecast you sent.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmeai.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmeai.com
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: baseline per-1M token rates and model list

Thanks, Dylan — that helps.

A bit more color on traffic mix:
- Chat (assistant UI): ~60% of tokens
- Embeddings (search): ~30% (high-cardinality queries, batched)
- Bulk completions (reporting / summarization): ~10%

We're interested in a committed pricing conversation — our procurement team prefers a three-tier band (Q1 ramp to 25M, Q2 50–75M, Q3 100M+). Can you indicate ballpark discount ranges for those bands and any minimum terms? Also, SOC2 Type II evidence: can you share the usual process / timeline for getting those artifacts?

Jordan
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Acme pricing ask — need margin check and approval for introductory credit/discount

Team — forwarding Acme's forecast and the mix. Requested discount bands:
- 25M/month band (intro year): target 7.5%
- 50–75M/month band: target 12%
- 100M+ band: target 18%

Acme is sensitive on pricing vs. latency; they'd like to keep rwd-llama-3-13b for UI but may use rwd-compact-quant for bulk completions to manage cost. Any objections to offering a 90-day intro credit equal to one month of committed spend to accelerate proof-of-value?

Ben — can you run a quick margin / P&L estimate and confirm whether 12% at 50–75M and a 90-day one-month credit is doable under our current hosted pricing? Laura, tagging for manager-level sign-off if needed.

-M
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Acme pricing ask — margin check

Quick read — with the projected mix (60% chat on rwd-llama-3-13b, 30% embeddings, 10% bulk quantized), margin profile looks healthy with these guardrails:
- 7.5% discount at 25M: OK for a 12-month term (we absorb via modest rebate)
- 12% at 50–75M: acceptable if contract includes 9–12 month minimum and standard throughput SLA
- 18% at 100M+: needs VP approval but plausible with firm 12-month+ commitment and annual prepay option

Intro credit: one month free (applied as invoice credit) OK for sales-approved POC (limit one per account). Recommend including a clause that pricing bands are volume-based and subject to reconciliation at quarter close.

SOC2: we can share our SOC2 Type II report under NDA; typical turnaround for redaction + share is 3–5 business days after legal/NDAs are signed.

Ben Carter
Pricing Operations Manager
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmeai.com>, procurement@acmeai.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: baseline per-1M token rates and model list

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the traffic breakdown. Short summary of what we can offer and next steps:

Baseline public hosted rates (attached for reference): Input $0.50 / 1M, Output $1.00 / 1M.

Committed bands (ballpark, subject to term & contract):
- Ramp to 25M/mo: 7.5% discount (12-month term recommended)
- 50–75M/mo: 12% discount (9–12 month minimum, standard SLA)
- 100M+/mo: 18% discount (requires VP approval; prepay option available)

Intro POC credit: one month of committed spend as invoice credit, available once per account (applies to first quarter).

SOC2 Type II: available after NDA; typical share time 3–5 business days.

Next steps:
1) If that range looks reasonable, I can put together a formal commercial term sheet and cost projection for your 12-month ramp.
2) Procurement: if you'd like the SOC2 under NDA, send over a standard mutual NDA and we'll route that to security.

Would you like us to model the costs with rwd-llama-3-13b for chat and rwd-embed-2 for search as the baseline? We can also provide a separate projection that substitutes rwd-compact-quant for bulk completions to show delta in monthly cost.

Thanks
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
